subject: Math
prompt: On January 1, $2005$, the enrollment of a school was $14,320$ students and on January 1, $2015$, the enrollment was $15,070$ students. The equation $10x + 14,320 = 15,070$ describes this situation. Which of the following is the best interpretation of $x$ in this context?

choices.A: The total increase in enrollment between $2005$ and $2015$
choices.B: The average increase per year of the enrollment between $2005$ and $2015$
choices.C: The percentage by which the enrollment of the school increased each year between $2005$ and $2015$
choices.D: The projected enrollment of the school $10$ years after $2015$

explanation: Choice B is correct. The equation $10x + 14{,}320 = 15{,}070$ models the enrollment change from $2005$ to $2015$. The structure of this equation is (rate × time) + initial value = final value. The coefficient $10$ represents the number of years between $2005$ and $2015$. Since the total increase in enrollment was $15{,}070 - 14{,}320 = 750$ students, and this increase occurred over $10$ years, the equation can be rewritten as $10x = 750$, which gives $x = 75$. This means $x$ represents the average increase in enrollment per year, which is $75$ students per year. The coefficient $10$ multiplied by the annual rate $x$ gives the total increase over the time period.
